name: dotnet
title: .NET SDK 10
description: The .NET 10 SDK (LTS): dotnet with the C#, F# and Visual Basic compilers, MSBuild and NuGet. Packages and state go to ~/.nuget and ~/.dotnet. Telemetry is off. Globalization runs in invariant mode unless you set DOTNET_SYSTEM_GLOBALIZATION_INVARIANT=0 and the system has ICU. Workloads (dotnet workload install) cannot be added: the toolchain is read-only.

smoke.run: dotnet new console -n hello >/dev/null && dotnet build hello -v q >/dev/null && dotnet hello/bin/Debug/net10.0/hello.dll

notes: The SHA-512 of dotnet/core's release-notes/10.0/releases.json (Microsoft publishes no signature for the archives). libssl.so.3 is loaded when a program uses TLS (NuGet): named in needs so that a host without it is refused. The glibc floor is the one .NET 10 documents; the build measures it.
